items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 9.2.8 at source lines 416-420: for functors F, G : A -> B and H, K : B -> C with natural transformations gamma : F -> G and delta : H -> K, the two composites (delta G)(H gamma) and (K gamma)(delta F) are equal. The author's proof (source lines 421-431) is a componentwise chase: after reducing to the component at an object a (line 422) it unfolds both whiskered composites (lines 424-426), and the single non-definitional step is the application of the naturality of delta at the component gamma_a (line 427), after which the two sides are seen to be the same displayed expression (lines 428-429). The statement is one identity between natural transformations and records neither the componentwise reduction nor which naturality square is used.
